Based on the provided healthcare Q&A matches, the warning signs of liver disease include:

- Yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice)
- Abdominal pain and swelling
- Swelling in legs and ankles
- Dark urine
- Pale stool
- Chronic fatigue
- Nausea
- Vomiting
- Tendency to bruise easily

Early stages of liver disease may have no symptoms, but it's essential to note that if you're experiencing any of these warning signs, it's crucial to consult a healthcare professional for proper evaluation and diagnosis.

Additionally, certain medications can cause liver damage as a side effect. If you're taking any prescription medications, be sure to discuss your liver health with your doctor or pharmacist.

Regular check-ups with your healthcare provider are vital in maintaining your overall well-being and detecting potential issues early on.
